gaps.lead: 'You copied my design!' she told him.
If I were in charge, overtime would be paid automatically.
gaps.explanation: Dropping 'if' inverts the subjunctive: Were I in charge…

gaps.lead: The ceremony will take place in the cathedral.
gaps.explanation: Ceremonies are held: will be held (in a venue).

gaps.lead: I only understood the pattern much later.
gaps.explanation: Front 'only + time phrase' forces inversion: Only much later did I understand.

gaps.lead: Simon really ought to make a decision about his future.
gaps.sentence: It's high time Simon ___ about his future.
gaps.hint: it's high time + past; make a decision = make up one's mind
gaps.explanation: 'It's high time' takes the past subjunctive: 'made up his mind'.
it's (high) time + subject + past simple = you should already be doing it.
